bio.text: Diamant Hysenaj is the Republican and Conservative candidate for New York's 14th Congressional District in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez.
According to his campaign website, he was born in Kosovo in 1982, came to the Bronx with his family in 1991 at age nine, and has lived in New York for 35 years.
His campaign website says he founded the construction company DCG New York Inc. in 2014 and has been married since 2017, with two children.
